summary: Empty sealed gardens bay 40 m east of the pin, no homes near.

best_section.where: Wide sealed bay east of the pin, below the road junction, ending at the curved Freedom Wall

drivers.seclusion: Gardens and bush all round; no dwellings mapped or visible.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed bay with a disabled marking, opens off the access road; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Gardens road runs just north; visitor and bus traffic by day.
drivers.convention: No vans or tents seen; looks like a visitor drop-off bay, overnight acceptance unknown.

flags: Pin itself is steep bush: 13% mean grade, 38% max
Slope at the bay not measured
Likely patrolled or closed at night as a gardens attraction
Mapped gate 286 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Mostly open sun; trees shade the west and north edges.
